diagnostic_history: Initial aggregate launch stalled before any test executed; only the owned runner was interrupted, and unchanged fixture rerun passed. It was not counted as app acceptance.
Android uiautomator occasionally failed idle detection; current screenshots were used as bounded evidence, never a stale hierarchy relabeled as a new pass.

One earlier native edit script sent 19 delete events for a 20-character fixture, leaving a leading character; observed field was corrected before exact saved-text verification. This was a fixture-script mistake, not an app workaround.
Historical 30/35/37 aggregate and original bootstrap outputs remain preserved; final numbers refer only to the final no-invented-freshness source run.
Fixture store key comparisons now assert booleans so failures do not print encryption material; standalone destructive tests require both opt-ins plus Android qemu preflight.
limitations: Real Ultrahuman account/API behavior remains unverified
Service-level mocked source lifecycle is not full source-action UI end-to-end acceptance
Native caffeine date/time entry validation was not exercised
Model explanation semantics remain rejected/held; deterministic fallback is not a model pass
Nothing Phone performance, storage, battery, heat and physical usability remain deferred
Broader personal-context correlation and independent prospective evaluation remain outside this collection acceptance
